recommendation_summary: Do now: swap in a new Cat6 patch cable and route it so the tight grommet doesn't pinch or kink it. No optional additions. If calls still drop, the follow-up is to try a different router port and report back. The UniFi gateway, managed switches and Grafana are rejected because nothing described needs them. Still open: the cable is only a suspect, not a confirmed cause.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked for dependable calls at the desk. The UniFi gateway, managed switches and Grafana come from your group's adoption trend, not from this failure.
labels.Deleted: UniFi gateway, managed switches, Grafana dashboard. Nothing you've described needs them.
labels.Bottleneck: The desk's own link. Two devices on the same router stay connected during a dropout, so the router and internet line are working.
labels.Checked myself: Nothing directly. I'm going on what you told me: the desk uses an old Ethernet cable through a tight grommet, other devices keep their calls, and the cable hasn't been swapped.

note: The reply gives all four record lines before a bounded cable-swap fix and names and rejects the UniFi/Grafana stack; it states the cable fix as if certain, but its 'Checked myself' line admits nothing was tested.
